main_idea: AfterQuery-data warmup lifts Nemotron 3 Ultra's GDPval score from 35.3 to 46.7.
ideas: Warmup raises GDPval score by 11.4 points
Warmed-up model nearly matches the teacher
Ultra has ~6x throughput of comparable open models
summary: A solid bar chart is cluttered by a blog tag, three stat cards (two repeat the bars, one is an unrelated throughput claim) and a footer URL; nothing is missing.
defects: Text in the 2.8 card overflows the bottom of its box
Text in the 6x card overflows the bottom of its box
Footnote wraps awkwardly and crowds the URL
